description: Sequencer built on a grid of cells that are on or off running Conway-style cellular automaton rules, read by up to sixteen play heads that count the cells that are on around them

params.text: Moves the play head across the columns; a right click on the grid sets it to the column clicked
Moves the play head across the rows; a right click on the grid sets it to the row clicked
Runs one generation of the automaton
Lets the Gen input run generations; while it is off only the Gen button does
Winds the grid back to how it stood at the last edit
The share of cells a random fill switches on, 0 to 1
Fills the grid at random, at the share set by Dens
The voltage one counted cell is worth at the CV outputs, 0.01V to 2V; at one twelfth of a volt each counted cell is a semitone
Lets the CvX input place the play heads; while it is off the CvX knob alone sets the column
Lets the CvY input place the play heads; while it is off the CvY knob alone sets the row

inputs.text: Places a play head on a column for each of its channels, the grid width spread over 0-10V, added to the CvX knob and wrapped around the grid
Places a play head on a row for each of its channels, the grid height spread over 0-10V, added to the CvY knob and wrapped around the grid
A rising edge runs one generation while On is lit
A rising edge winds the grid back to how it stood at the last edit
Switches the On button on above 1V and off below
Sets the random density, 0-10V across the whole range, and overrides the Dens knob while patched
Sets the level, 0-10V across the whole range, and overrides the Lvl knob while patched
Fills the grid at random while the voltage here is above 1V
Switches the CvX On button on above 1V and off below
Switches the CvY On button on above 1V and off below
Sets which neighbour counts switch a cell that is off on, one channel per count from none to eight, above 0V for a count that gives birth; it is read only while the survive input is patched as well
Sets which neighbour counts keep a cell that is on switched on, one channel per count from none to eight, above 0V for a count that survives; it is read only while the birth input is patched as well

outputs.text: A 10ms trigger on a play head's channel when the head moves onto a cell that is on, or when the cell under it is switched on
Counts the cells that are on in the row left of the play head and multiplies that count by the level, one channel per play head
Counts the cells that are on in the row right of the play head and multiplies that count by the level, one channel per play head
Counts the cells that are on in the column above the play head and multiplies that count by the level, one channel per play head
Counts the cells that are on in the column below the play head and multiplies that count by the level, one channel per play head
Counts the cells that are on on the diagonal above and left of the play head and multiplies that count by the level, one channel per play head
Counts the cells that are on on the diagonal above and right of the play head and multiplies that count by the level, one channel per play head
Counts the cells that are on on the diagonal below and left of the play head and multiplies that count by the level, one channel per play head
Counts the cells that are on on the diagonal below and right of the play head and multiplies that count by the level, one channel per play head
Carries the level voltage while the play head is on a cell that is on and 0V while it is not, one channel per play head
Carries 10V on a play head's channel while that head is on a cell that is on
Passes the Gen input through on a play head's channel while that head is on a cell that is on and On is lit

notes: the grid comes up with every cell off, so the counts are all zero and no gate fires: click cells on, press Rnd for a random fill, or paste a pattern in from the clipboard
clicking a cell in the grid switches it on or off, and right clicking moves the play head to that cell
menu: size — sets the width and height of the grid, any value from 8 to 32
Paste RLE from Clipboard — reads a run length encoded pattern from the system clipboard and writes it in at the play head
Rule — picks the automaton rule: B3/S23, B34/S34, B234/S, B2/S, B1/S1, B36/S125, B345/S5, B2/S2 or B2/S1, each run on a torus so the edges wrap around
